brief: A lidded box for the glovebox: a screwdriver stored inside a cell with a cover closing the top over it.

requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:0,0,1;full, piece:1,0,1;full with connector:0 and connector:1; top covers cover:0,0,1;full;top and cover:1,0,1;full;top close the top. meshClash clear.
requirements.requirement: Lidded box for the glovebox (cells with covers closing the top)

requirements.evidence: Screwdriver prop (261 mm) is longer than a cell/bin floor (~142 mm); dry-run rested but adding the full top cover gave PROP_INSIDE overlap and the screwdriver had to be removed. No screwdriver is stored under the closed covers on the finished build.
requirements.requirement: Screwdriver stored inside a cell with a cover closing the top over it

finish.summary: Built a 2-cell, 2-storey lidded box with top covers closed, but the 261 mm screwdriver prop overlaps the cover and cannot sit inside a closed cell, so it was left out.

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
